race.comment: STORMING HOME (4) didn't have much luck two back at Eagle Farm when charging late, and then left herself with too much to do last time. Thompson sticks fourth-up, don't expect them to make the same mistake again. TALK ABOUT LAYLA (7) ticked off the maiden in style three back at the Goldy and has progressed well since. Holds the ledger over a couple of these but does concede a little weight to them now. TIVACIOUS (3) caught the eye on debut before progressing nicely last start here to score with a bit up his sleeve. The positive tactics proved decisive at the latest, so will be interesting to see what tactics are employed from out there. VANDEVELDE (1) has been hitting the line strongly over shorter trips and looks ready for the mile. In the mix.
